title.ja: 画像をアップロードする: presigned URL と S3
title.en: Upload Images: Presigned URLs and S3

services: API Gateway HTTP API JWT authorizer

sources.title: Download and upload objects with presigned URLs
supports: A presigned URL uses the credentials of the principal who generated it, and its capabilities are limited by that principal's permissions
Presigned URLs are bearer tokens that grant access to those who possess them, and can be used multiple times until they expire
A presigned URL made with temporary credentials expires when those credentials expire, even if a later expiration was requested
With the AWS CLI or SDKs the expiration can be set as high as 7 days
S3 checks the expiration at the time of the HTTP request
A bucket policy can deny presigned requests by signature age with the s3:signatureAge condition key
sources.note: The page gives typical credential lifetimes for EC2 instance profiles, ECS tasks, and STS AssumeRole. It gives none for a Lambda execution role.

sources.title: Uploading objects with presigned URLs
supports: An upload to a key that already exists replaces the existing object
The content type in the upload request must match the one given when the presigned PUT URL was generated

sources.title: POST Policy
supports: A POST policy holds an expiration and a list of conditions the request must meet
content-length-range sets the minimum and maximum allowable size of the uploaded content
Conditions support exact matching and starts-with matching on fields such as key and Content-Type
Each form field except x-amz-signature, file, policy, and x-ignore- fields must appear in the list of conditions
sources.note: On 2026-10-11 the older path /AmazonS3/latest/API/sigv4-HTTPPOSTConstructPolicy.html redirected to the API reference index; the page was read at the /developerguide/ path. Its conditions table does not list the tagging field by name.

sources.title: POST Object
supports: The file must be the last field in the form
POST Object has a tagging form field that takes an XML tag set
success_action_status defaults to 204
A request without a policy is anonymous and works only on publicly writable buckets
sources.note: Read at the /developerguide/ path, as the /API/ path redirected to the index on 2026-10-11.

sources.title: Authenticating Requests: Using Query Parameters (AWS Signature Version 4)
supports: X-Amz-Expires is between 1 and 604800 seconds
The host header and any x-amz-* headers must be signed, and signing every header you plan to send is recommended
A presigned URL made with STS credentials carries X-Amz-Security-Token
sources.note: The page does not state a rule for content-length specifically. That a signed Content-Length pins the size of a presigned PUT was not confirmed.

sources.title: How to prevent object overwrites with conditional writes
supports: If-None-Match prevents overwriting an existing key
If-None-Match can be used with PutObject, CompleteMultipartUpload, and CopyObject; POST Object is not in the list

sources.title: HeadObject
supports: For a key that does not exist, S3 returns 404 if the caller has s3:ListBucket on the bucket and 403 if it does not

sources.title: Expiring objects
supports: In a nonversioned bucket, S3 queues an expired object for removal and removes it asynchronously
Tag-based filters are evaluated daily, and the object's current tags are re-evaluated when the action executes; if the tag is gone, the expiration does not proceed
There may be a delay between the expiration date and the removal, and expired objects are not charged for storage
A bucket policy cannot prevent deletions by a lifecycle rule

sources.title: Configuring a bucket lifecycle configuration to delete incomplete multipart uploads
supports: AWS recommends a lifecycle rule with AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload to minimize storage costs
The rule aborts multipart uploads not completed within the given number of days and deletes their parts; it deletes no objects

sources.title: Tagging your objects
supports: Tags can be set in a POST Object request
Lifecycle rules can filter on object tags
DELETE Object tagging removes the tag set without a request charge, where PUT Object tagging is billed as a Tier 1 request

sources.title: Using cross-origin resource sharing (CORS)
supports: S3 uses the first CORS rule whose origin, method, and requested headers match the request
ACLs and policies continue to apply when CORS is enabled

sources.title: Elements of a CORS configuration
supports: AllowedMethods accepts GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, and HEAD
AllowedOrigins lists the origins allowed to make cross-origin requests

sources.title: Blocking public access to your Amazon S3 storage
supports: The four settings BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, and RestrictPublicBuckets

sources.title: What is Amazon S3? (Strong consistency)
supports: S3 provides strong read-after-write consistency for PUT and DELETE of objects, and reads of object tags and metadata such as HEAD are strongly consistent
sources.note: The sentence names PUT and DELETE. It does not name POST Object.

sources.title: @aws-sdk/s3-presigned-post 3.1149.0 (type definitions and source)
supports: createPresignedPost signs locally and sends no request
Each entry in Fields becomes an exact-match condition, and Conditions accepts content-length-range
The session token of temporary credentials is added as the X-Amz-Security-Token field

sources.title: AWS Price List bulk API: Data Transfer, ap-northeast-1
supports: Unit prices in data/pricing/unit-prices.json with offerCode AWSDataTransfer
Data transfer in from the internet is USD 0.000 per GB in ap-northeast-1
sources.note: The first tier is described as "beyond the global free tier". The size of that free tier was not confirmed.

sources.title: Cloudflare R2: Presigned URLs
supports: R2 presigned URLs support GET, HEAD, PUT, and DELETE; POST form uploads are not currently supported
R2 presigned URLs work on the S3 API domain and cannot be used with custom domains
R2's documentation also calls presigned URLs bearer tokens

sources.title: Working with Lambda environment variables
supports: Lambda sets AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN to the access keys obtained from the function's execution role
sources.note: The page does not say how long these credentials stay valid.

definition.ja: 署名を URL に含めた、期限つきの URL。持っている人は、署名した人の権限の範囲で、決められた 1 つの操作を実行できる。
definition.en: A URL that carries a signature and an expiry. Whoever holds it can perform one fixed operation, within the permissions of whoever signed it.

definition.ja: ブラウザからの form による S3 へのアップロードが満たすべき条件（key、種類、大きさの範囲、期限）を書いた、署名つきの文書。
definition.en: A signed document listing the conditions (key, type, size range, expiry) that a browser's form upload to S3 must meet.

definition.ja: bucket の中で object を一意に指す名前。`/` を含められるが、フォルダーがあるわけではない。
definition.en: The name that identifies an object within a bucket. It may contain `/`, but there are no folders.

definition.ja: 持っているだけで使える認証情報。誰が使っているかは確かめられない。
definition.en: A credential that works for whoever holds it. Nothing checks who that is.

definition.ja: 条件に合う object を、作成から一定の日数の後に S3 自身が削除（または移動）する、bucket の設定。
definition.en: A bucket setting under which S3 itself deletes (or moves) matching objects a number of days after they were created.

definition.ja: ACL や bucket policy で bucket や object を公開する設定を、拒否または無効にする S3 の 4 つの設定。
definition.en: Four S3 settings that reject or ignore ACLs and bucket policies that would make a bucket or object public.

definition.ja: bucket にはあるが、それを指す記録がどこにも無い object。誰にも見えないまま、保存料金だけがかかる。
definition.en: An object that is in the bucket while no record points at it. Nobody sees it, and it is still billed for storage.

definition.ja: 大きな object を複数の part に分けて送る S3 の仕組み。完了も中止もされなかった part は、保存されたまま残る。
definition.en: S3's way of sending a large object in parts. Parts of an upload that is neither completed nor aborted stay stored.

title.ja: 画像の添付: 月 10,000 枚のアップロード、100,000 回の表示
title.en: Image attachments: 10,000 uploads and 100,000 views a month

ja: 06章のノートアプリの料金に上乗せされる分だけを数える
画像は 1 枚 1 MB。月に 10,000 枚がアップロードされ、すべて添付まで完了する。月末の保存量は 10 GB
ノートを開くたびに添付の一覧を 1 回呼び、画像を 1 枚読み込む。それが月に 100,000 回。ブラウザの cache は効かないものとする
S3 へのリクエスト: アップロードの POST が 10,000、HeadObject が 10,000、画像の GET が 100,000。tag を外すリクエストは請求されない。削除のリクエストは未算入
API は許可の発行 10,000、完了 10,000、一覧 100,000 の計 120,000 リクエスト。Lambda は平均 60 ミリ秒、256 MB、arm64
DynamoDB の読み取りは、許可の発行で 2、完了で 3、一覧で 2 unit。書き込みは完了のたびに 1 unit
アップロードのデータ転送（インターネットから S3 へ）は 0。未完了のアップロード、tag の保存料金、掃除のための LIST は未算入
en: Counts only what is added on top of the notes app of chapter 06
Each image is 1 MB. 10,000 are uploaded in the month and every one is attached. 10 GB are stored at the end of the month
Opening a note calls the attachment list once and loads one image, 100,000 times a month. The browser cache is assumed not to help
Requests to S3: 10,000 upload POSTs, 10,000 HeadObject calls, and 100,000 image GETs. Removing the tag is not billed. Delete requests are not included
The API serves 10,000 permits, 10,000 finishes, and 100,000 lists: 120,000 requests. Lambda averages 60 ms at 256 MB on arm64
DynamoDB reads: 2 units for a permit, 3 for a finish, 2 for a list. One write unit per finish
Data transfer for uploads (internet to S3) is 0. Unfinished uploads, tag storage, and the LIST requests of a sweep are not included

items.basis: 120,000 x 0.06 s x 0.25 GB, in GB-seconds

note.ja: 認可（他人のノートは 404、key は token からのみ）、許可証の中身、完了と期限と上限、途中で止めた場合の S3 と DynamoDB の状態、掃除、同じ form の再送、SDK が作る POST policy と presigned GET（偽の認証情報で署名のみ）、DynamoDB へのリクエストの形、インフラの assertion
note.en: Authorization (another user's note is a 404; the key comes only from the token), permit contents, finishing with its deadline and limit, the state of S3 and DynamoDB when stopped partway, the sweep, the replay of a form, the POST policy and presigned GET the SDK produces (signed with made-up credentials only), the shape of DynamoDB requests, and infrastructure assertions

records.command: vp run dev:uploads:api + vp run dev:uploads:web + ブラウザの自動操作 / browser automation

note.ja: サインイン、ノートの作成、ファイルを選んで画像が表示されること、別の利用者の許可・一覧・完了が 404、大きすぎるファイル・違う種類・違う key の拒否、完了の再実行、削除とノートの削除の後に画像の URL が読めないことを確認。相手はメモリ上の実装で、S3 ではない
note.en: Checked sign-in, creating a note, choosing a file and seeing the image, a 404 for another user's permit, list, and finish, refusal of an oversized file, another type, and another key, finishing twice, and the image URL no longer loading after a delete and after deleting the note. The store was the in-memory implementation, not S3

records.command: vp run uploads:infra:synth / build:uploads:web / typecheck:uploads:web / lint:uploads:web / typecheck

note.ja: 06章と同じ 19 種類のリソース。Cognito 用のコードと scripts/ は型検査のみ
note.en: The same 19 resource types as chapter 06. The Cognito code path and scripts/ are type-checked only

records.command: S3 互換のローカル実装での確認 / a run against an S3-compatible local implementation

note.ja: タスクを用意していない。Docker の daemon が要り、執筆環境では動いていなかった
note.en: No task is provided. It needs a Docker daemon, which was not running where this was written

records.command: vp run uploads:infra:diff / deploy / drift / destroy, uploads:user:create, uploads:publish, uploads:smoke:web, uploads:smoke:api, uploads:sweep, uploads:empty, uploads:unpublish

note.ja: bucket を 2 つ、user pool、distribution、table を作る。S3 への presigned POST、lifecycle rule、CORS、DynamoDB への添付の記録は、どれも実環境で未確認
note.en: Creates two buckets, a user pool, a distribution, and a table. The presigned POST to S3, the lifecycle rules, CORS, and attachment records in DynamoDB are all unconfirmed in AWS

summary.ja: 07章: presigned POST を実物の S3 に送っていない。とくに、form の tagging の欄を S3 が policy の条件 {"tagging": ...} で受け付けるかは、POST policy の条件の表に tagging が載っていないため未確認。content-length-range と Content-Type による拒否、bucket の CORS、POST 直後の HeadObject も未確認。
summary.en: Chapter 07: the presigned POST has never been sent to real S3. In particular, whether S3 accepts the form's tagging field under the policy condition {"tagging": ...} is unconfirmed, because the table of POST policy conditions does not list tagging. Refusal by content-length-range and Content-Type, the bucket's CORS, and HeadObject right after the POST are unconfirmed too.

resume.ja: vp run uploads:infra:deploy、uploads:user:create、uploads:publish の後、サインインして得た access token を AIH_ACCESS_TOKEN に入れて vp run uploads:smoke:api を実行する。tagging で拒否された場合は、アップロード先を別の接頭辞にして完了時に CopyObject する設計に替える。
resume.en: After vp run uploads:infra:deploy, uploads:user:create, and uploads:publish, sign in, put the access token into AIH_ACCESS_TOKEN, and run vp run uploads:smoke:api. If S3 refuses the tagging field, switch to uploading under a separate prefix and copying the object on finish.

summary.ja: 07章: pending の tag が付いた object を lifecycle rule が消すこと、tag を外した object は消さないこと、cdkd が lifecycle と CORS の設定を作成・読み戻しできることは未確認。
summary.en: Chapter 07: that the lifecycle rule deletes objects tagged pending, that it leaves objects whose tag was removed, and that cdkd can create and read back the lifecycle and CORS settings are all unconfirmed.

resume.ja: デプロイ後、完了を呼ばないアップロードと完了したアップロードを 1 つずつ作り、2 日後に vp run uploads:sweep と vp run uploads:infra:drift で確かめる。
resume.en: After deploying, make one upload that is never finished and one that is, then check two days later with vp run uploads:sweep and vp run uploads:infra:drift.

summary.ja: 07章: Lambda の実行 role の一時認証情報の寿命を、一次情報で確認できなかった。presigned URL が期限前に切れる頻度は不明。
summary.en: Chapter 07: the lifetime of the temporary credentials of a Lambda execution role could not be confirmed from a primary source. How often a presigned URL expires early is unknown.

resume.ja: Lambda の公式ドキュメントで数値を探す。見つからなければ、デプロイした関数で認証情報の Expiration を記録して観測値として書く。
resume.en: Look for a figure in the official Lambda documentation. Failing that, record the credentials' expiration in a deployed function and report it as an observation.

summary.ja: 07章: 完了した後、許可証の期限内（5 分）に同じ form を再送すると、object が pending に戻り、1 日後に記録だけが残る。invariant の穴として本文とテストに書いたが、閉じていない。
summary.en: Chapter 07: replaying the same form within the permit's lifetime (5 minutes) after finishing puts the object back to pending, and a day later only the record is left. Written up as a gap in the prose and in a test, and not closed.

resume.ja: presigned PUT と If-None-Match に替える（Content-Length の署名で大きさを固定できるかを先に実機で確かめる）か、許可証の期限後に tag をもう一度外す処理を足す。
resume.en: Switch to a presigned PUT with If-None-Match (after confirming on real S3 that a signed Content-Length pins the size), or add a step that removes the tag again after the permit expires.
